purpose: Supply the original scalar definition and small-distortion domain needed before CAS-07-C03; the monotonicity conclusion is not an input premise.

definitions.Kc: Real curvature-majorant parameter with Kc >= 0 and units L^-2.
definitions.f: For t>0, f(Kc,t)=sinh(sqrt(Kc)*t)/sqrt(Kc) when Kc>0, and f(0,t)=t.
definitions.x: Dimensionless auxiliary x=sqrt(Kc)*t on the Kc>0 branch. It is a derived abbreviation, not an independent assumption.

admitted_assumptions: eta(Kc,L) < 1, retained from the original CAS-07 small-distortion domain
target: eta(Kc,s) < 1 as the consequence of the preceding bound and the supplied eta(Kc,L)<1
proof_obligations: Treat Kc=0 separately and obtain eta(0,t)=0 from the literal branch definition.
For Kc>0 prove sinh(x)/x >= 1 for x>0.
For Kc>0 prove t |-> sinh(sqrt(Kc)*t)/(sqrt(Kc)*t)-1 is nondecreasing on positive t; any derivative argument must prove the derivative sign rather than assume it.
Preserve universal quantification over the declared real domain; finite samples or a truncated series do not prove the target.

branches_and_limits.Kc_zero: Use f(0,t)=t exactly; do not divide by sqrt(Kc).
branches_and_limits.Kc_positive: Use the principal positive real square root.
branches_and_limits.s_zero: Outside this target because 0<s. No eta(0-length) continuity theorem is claimed.
branches_and_limits.s_equals_L: Included and should reduce the upper bound to equality.

forbidden: Assuming eta>=0, eta(s)<=eta(L), derivative nonnegativity, or the target as a premise.
Importing a provenance-only derivation or another axis's scripts/results before adjudication.
Re-running or claiming CAS-07-C01 initial-value, ODE, integral-identity, or Kc-to-zero limit obligations.
Using Jacobi existence, curvature-to-majorization, Taylor regularity, FD1/FD2/FD3, or physical-distance conclusions as shortcuts.

dependency_binding.accepted_scope: Finite positive Euclidean observer/screen convention only; no proof-source reuse.
C01 is already completed. Only its accepted literal f definition is referenced; its scripts, derivations, and results are not author inputs and its obligations are not rerun.
C02 conditional determinant theorem is completed and independent of M01. It will be combined with M01 only after both accepted statements are matched for C03.

authorization: Owner-directed continuation of all remaining proofs. This is the original explicitly listed scalar monotonicity obligation, separated so its conclusion is proved rather than silently supplied to C03.
claim_ceiling: Exact scalar analytic prerequisite only; no full finite-distance theorem, physics, observation, or scientific admission.
